basic_details.scholarship_name: Hanyang University International Graduate Scholarship (HISP & HIEA)
basic_details.offering_entity: Hanyang University (Office of International Affairs & College of Computing)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Hanyang University Seoul & ERICA Campuses (Seoul / Ansan, South Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: College of Computing (Seoul Campus) & Department of Computer Software, Department of Artificial Intelligence, and College of Computing and Software (ERICA Campus).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 to 150 HISP scholarships (50%, 70%, or 100% tuition waivers) awarded per semester to international graduate students
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates represent a strong presence in engineering and computer software (~12 to 20 awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for MS; up to 4 years for PhD (or 4 years for combined MS-PhD), renewed each semester based on GPA

nationality_requirements: International applicants holding non-Korean citizenship whose parents are also non-Korean
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for MS; recognized Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM field from an HEC-recognized university with strong academic standing (minimum 75% aggregate or CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.50+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 80% or 3.0/4.0 from previous degree; top HISP 100% waiver recipients typically exceed 3.60 on a 4.0 scale.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Coursework in data structures, algorithms, computer architecture, operating systems, and discrete mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year students can apply conditionally; final degree certificate required before enrollment.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; technical publications or software engineering projects enhance competitiveness.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.0, TOEFL iBT min 80, or institutional English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. Korean language proficiency (TOPIK) is not required for English-track computing departments.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; graduate research and coursework in Computer Software are conducted 100% in English. Free Korean language classes offered on campus.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: HISP is awarded automatically based on admissions dossier review (no separate application). Lab professors frequently provide living stipends via BK21 (Brain Korea 21) funds.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another Korean government full tuition scholarship simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% tuition waiver (HISP 100% tier) covering full graduate tuition fees (~KRW 6,500,000 to KRW 7,500,000 / semester; ~KRW 14,000,000 / year value; ~USD 10,500 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: Hanyang University international graduate online application fee of KRW 138,000 (~USD 100) paid online via credit card.

accommodation.details: On-campus international graduate dormitories (Techno Dormitory, Smart Dormitory at ERICA) or private student housing (One-room / Goshiwon near Wangsimni or ERICA campus) average KRW 350,000 to 550,000/month (~USD 260 to 415/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Living stipend provided by advising professor through BK21 Four (Brain Korea 21) and National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) grants: MS students receive KRW 800,000 to KRW 1,200,000 / month (~USD 600 to 900 / month; ~PKR 168,000 to 252,000 / month); PhD students receive KRW 1,300,000 to KRW 1,800,000 / month (~USD 980 to 1,350 / month; ~PKR 273,000 to 378,000 / month).

airfare.details: International flights between Pakistan and Seoul Incheon International Airport (ICN) are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Korean D-2 Student Visa application fee paid to Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Islamabad (~USD 60; ~PKR 17,000).

health_insurance.details: Mandatory enrollment in the Korean National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) provides 70-80% coverage for all medical and hospital care; international student monthly premium is heavily discounted (~KRW 75,000 / month; ~USD 56/month), paid out of monthly stipend.

food_allowance.details: Campus cafeterias (Saraban, Student Union dining) offer hot Korean and international meals for KRW 4,500 to 6,500 per meal; easily covered by the monthly lab stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Hanyang Paiknam Academic Information Center, GPU clusters, AI servers, and software licenses in the College of Computing.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: BK21 Four and NRF research grants cover full travel, registration, and hotel costs for presenting research papers at international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Seoul Metropolitan Subway Line 2 has direct on-campus station (Hanyang University Station); T-money transit card allows convenient and affordable commuting.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single leading South Korean engineering powerhouse: Hanyang University (Seoul & ERICA Campuses, South Korea)
participating_institutions: Hanyang University - College of Computing (Seoul Campus)
Department of Computer Software & Department of Artificial Intelligence
College of Computing and Software (ERICA Campus)
BK21 Four Research Groups in AI and Software Engineering
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 150 global university (QS World #162, THE World #301); renowned as the 'Engine of Korea' for producing chief technology officers (CTOs) and engineers across Samsung, LG, and Hyundai.
available_majors: MS / PhD in Electronic and Computer Engineering
MS / PhD in Applied Artificial Intelligence
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MS: 2 years; PhD: 4 years; MS-PhD Combined: 4 years full-time.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS (for MS) or MS (for PhD) in CS/STEM with 3.2+ GPA, transcripts, study plan, CV, 2 recommendation letters, and English proficiency (IELTS 6.0+ or TOEFL 80+ or MOI).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Artificial Intelligence and Computer Vision labs in Seoul campus attract intense applicant competition; Computer Software, Data Science, and ERICA campus computing labs offer higher admission and funding likelihood.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Connecting with a professor in Hanyang's Department of Computer Software prior to submitting your application is highly recommended; professors with active BK21 Four or NRF grants can provide guaranteed monthly living stipends on top of your HISP tuition waiver.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Hanyang University International Graduate Admissions Portal & StudyinKorea Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Hanyang OIA online application portal during the application window (September-October for Spring; March-April for Fall), complete personal details, upload required documents, and submit before deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (August - September for Spring / January - February for Fall): Explore Hanyang CS faculty lab websites and email prospective professors with CV and research statement.
Step 2 (Online portal): Access the Hanyang University International Graduate Admissions online portal.
Step 3 (Complete application): Fill out application form, select target degree program, and indicate prospective lab supervisor (if contacted).
Step 4 (Upload documents): Upload certified PDF scans of transcripts, degree certificates, study plan, CV, 2 recommendation letters, and English certificate / MOI letter.
Step 5 (Fee payment): Pay KRW 138,000 application fee online and submit.
Step 6 (Faculty review & interview): College of Computing admissions committee reviews dossiers and may conduct virtual interviews.
Step 7 (Admission & HISP announcement): Admission decision and HISP scholarship award notification released simultaneously on the portal.
Step 8 (Certificate of Admission): Formally accept offer, receive Certificate of Admission (CoA), and apply for Korean D-2 Student Visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic consideration: All international applicants are automatically evaluated for the HISP scholarship based on their application dossier; no separate scholarship application required.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly to the admissions portal or submitted by referees via automated links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Study Plan / Statement of Purpose: (1) Motivations for choosing Hanyang University, (2) Previous academic and research achievements, (3) Detailed study and research plan in target field, (4) Future career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured 2 to 3-page study plan detailing research interests, technical tools, and prospective lab alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing education, programming proficiencies, research publications, and capstone projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Some faculty lab PIs conduct a 20-30 minute virtual technical interview via Zoom to evaluate coding proficiency and research background before confirming lab placement.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.0+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or English Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate. GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Notarized or apostilled degree certificates and transcripts uploaded; HEC attestation and MOFA attestation required for Pakistani credentials.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Notarized English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the Hanyang International Graduate Admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Notarized copy of Bachelor's degree (for MS) or Master's degree (for PhD) certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit HEC-attested degree certificates; provisional certificate accepted for final-year students.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale explanation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured 2-3 page essay articulating academic background, research interests, and study plan at Hanyang.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight alignment with Hanyang computer software research groups and technical skills.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly link GitHub repositories, hackathons, and published work.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two recommendation letters signed by university professors detailing academic competence.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit on official university letterhead with institutional email (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.document_name: English Language Proficiency Certificate or MOI
required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS (6.0+), TOEFL (80+), or official Medium of Instruction (MOI) certificate from university registrar.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Official English MOI letter from Pakistani university registrar is accepted by Hanyang University.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Passport Identification Page & Family Relation Proof
required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport bio-data page and birth certificate or family registration certificate (FRC).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: NADRA Family Registration Certificate (FRC) in English proving non-Korean parentage.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two admissions cycles per year: Spring semester (starts March, deadline October) and Fall semester (starts September, deadline April).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (Academic record, undergraduate/master's GPA, performance in core computing coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Quality of final year project, thesis, technical publications, lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Relevant software engineering or research lab experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Quality of study plan and alignment with faculty research)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Qualifying factor (virtual lab interview with prospective advisor)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: College of Computing Admissions Committee and Office of International Affairs Scholarship Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Two-stage evaluation: Faculty committees evaluate candidate dossiers on academic record, research capability, and study plan. Top candidates are awarded HISP 100%, 70%, or 50% tuition waivers, with lab advisors appointing students to funded BK21/NRF research assistantships.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 2,200+ international graduate applicants across Hanyang University
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~100 to 150 HISP scholarship packages awarded per semester
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~12% to 18% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/SE/EE from recognized Pakistani university (FAST, NUST, UET, GIKI, COMSATS), strong programming skills, solid study plan, MOI or IELTS 6.5+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore/Taxila, GIKI, and COMSATS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, Pakistan, Vietnam, India, Indonesia, Russia, Kazakhstan

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed admission or scholarships at Hanyang. Applications are processed strictly via oia.hanyang.ac.kr.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Hanyang application fee is KRW 138,000 paid online directly to the university. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Hanyang works with authorized recruitment agencies for undergraduate admissions, but graduate research placements are handled directly by professors. Never pay agents for scholarship placement.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Korean D-2 Student Visa fee: USD 60 (~PKR 17,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Seoul: ~PKR 200,000 to 320,000.
First month's dorm deposit and living costs: ~KRW 600,000 (~PKR 126,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: You must take TOPIK (Korean language test). (FACT: 100% of graduate computing courses and research in Computer Software are in English; TOPIK is not required).
CLAIM: The HISP scholarship covers living expenses. (FACT: The HISP scholarship covers tuition fees only; living stipends are provided separately by your research lab professor via BK21/NRF grants).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online blogs state that HISP renewal requires a 4.0 GPA. In fact, maintaining the HISP scholarship requires maintaining a minimum GPA of 3.00 on a 4.0 scale each semester.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher each semester to retain the HISP tuition waiver for the following semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research enrollment on campus in Seoul or ERICA.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester credit completion and GPA verification by the Office of International Affairs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: International students holding a D-2 visa can work part-time up to 20 hours per week during term time and 40 hours per week during vacations with immigration permission.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for the Korean D-10 Job Search visa (up to 2 years) or E-7 professional work visa in Korea's world-leading tech sector (Samsung, Naver, Kakao, LG).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; semester GPA falling below 3.0 results in loss of tuition waiver for subsequent term.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing department requires formal approval from both departments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Master's scholarship capped at 2 years; PhD scholarship capped at 4 years. Professor funding can continue beyond.
